title: Research
intro: Research reports on AI platforms, agents, and infrastructure.  Each report is password-protected.

reports.title: Sizing GPU Capacity for Long-Context Agentic Inference
reports.summary: How serving layout, numeric precision, and GPU generation trade total throughput against per-agent speed, with a planning model and a validation plan.

reports.title: Sub-Second Isolated Workspaces for Coding Agents
reports.summary: Designing a self-hosted service that hands an agent an isolated workspace in under half a second: latency budget, isolation choices, warm pools, harness capabilities, and controls.

reports.title: Where Specialist Data Science Platforms Fit in an Owned AI Architecture
reports.summary: Which work belongs inside specialist authoring and workflow platforms, which decisions a central AI platform should own, and how to test the difference.

reports.title: Continuously Tuned Inference for an Owned, Mixed GPU Fleet
reports.summary: How a control loop that keeps re-tuning serving configuration as models, traffic, and hardware change could raise the yield of an owned, multi-generation fleet, with a bounded experiment program.

reports.title: Offering Model Fine-Tuning as an Internal Service
reports.summary: Market options and reference stacks for a self-service fine-tuning offering on owned and cloud accelerators, with a phased build plan.

reports.title: Operating Model for a Regulated GPU Platform
reports.summary: How to organize reliability, platform engineering, and automation for a self-service on-premises GPU platform, with illustrative scenarios and discovery questions.

reports.title: Portable Agent Environments: A Capability Matrix and Conformance Protocol
reports.summary: Why a common create, run, and delete interface for agent environments is not enough, and how a capability-aware adapter and conformance tests make execution portable without hiding risky differences.

reports.title: From Conversation to Authorized Work: Designing an Agentic Work Triage Workbench
reports.summary: A design vision for a calm workbench that turns messages into reviewable proposals and carries a person's decision through to agent execution.

reports.title: Four Windows on a Running Machine: What Visible Reasoning Is For
reports.summary: Why transparency is too broad a reason to show an assistant's work in progress, and the distinct jobs a visible trace can do.

reports.title: The Fourth Currency: Why Model Pickers Ask the Wrong Question
reports.summary: Choosing a model bundles guesses about speed, cost, and quality; this essay proposes letting people state the goal instead.

reports.title: Dispatching Work Across Heterogeneous Agent Runtimes
reports.summary: A specification for describing agent work once and running it on laptops, isolated sandboxes, self-hosted workers, or managed services, with authority and evidence that follow the work.

reports.title: When the Laptop Closes: Distributed Intelligence and the Enterprise
reports.summary: What it would take for agent work to continue after a developer closes the laptop, and how that changes what an enterprise buys when it buys AI.

reports.title: Microplatforms and the Boundaries of Agent Autonomy
reports.summary: How an operating model of agents near the work, shared context, and central infrastructure sets practical limits on agent autonomy.

reports.title: Inference Acceleration Options for an Owned GPU Cluster
reports.summary: How to compare serving engines, orchestration layers, and commercial accelerators against an open baseline on owned hardware, and what evidence to require.

reports.title: Serving a Two-Model Agentic Coding Platform on an Owned GPU Pod
reports.summary: A runnable design, validation, and operations playbook for routing and serving two models behind one endpoint, with a pilot-scale supplement.

reports.title: Designing an Internal AI Compute Service Catalog
reports.summary: Six product families for an internal AI compute offering, the choices customers should get, and the platform capabilities underneath.

reports.title: Giving an Existing Agent a Voice: The Composable Voice Stack
reports.summary: An architectural assessment of adding real-time voice to an existing agent from interchangeable speech, transport, and orchestration components.

reports.title: Digital Double: An Open Standard for Portable Personal Memory
reports.summary: A proposed open standard for keeping personal memory in files you own, with audiences, provenance, and rules for what other assistants may read or write.
